name: Fujibayashi Gen'ya
source:
"If it's a mission, I'll do it. Just as long as I don't die."

Gen'ya has the same abilities as his twin brother Sakuya, but he tries to live an easy life in handling his hands. The true face that such a 'ne'er do well' shows only to you—

Temperament: Appropriate and hassle-free
Familiar: Oboro

[Information taken from the official character profile.]
